lensFocus.spec: This run implements docs/plans/2026-11-05-hub-notices.md for issue .scratch/vecnet/issues/41-hub-notices-and-relocation.md. Check the identity key (separate from hub_key, migration 0019, challenge bound to public_url, offline cross-signed rotation), notices (operator-only, signed, one per kind, hub_notice Events per enabled peer, expiry, boot clear), the hub_restarting frame (no id, inside ShutdownGrace) and long-poll field, --relocated-to (410 hub_moved for reads and writes, no workers), the CLI pin/TOFU sidecar, profile edits, follow rules, and every surface (watch --for-monitor, TUI, web).
lensFocus.security: No client ever redirects to a hub that has not proved the pinned key: notice signature against the pin, target public_url == new_url, fresh challenge signature; peer text is never parsed for moves; replayed notices are ignored; watch verifies identity before sending its bearer; config.toml is never rewritten except by a verified, re-decoded line-level edit with .bak; relocated hubs run no workers; notice text is inert on every surface; GET /v1/hub/identity reveals only the public key and public_url.
lensFocus.tests: Each named plan test exists and fails without its fix; guard tests are marked; no test touches the real ~/.config/vecnet; relocation tests use testhub.CloneDB and Relocate, never the network; screen scripts wait on state, honour SHOTS_DIR, never bind 45752 or 49575.
